t: What Cross-Language Knowledge Mapping Database Is All About
title: What Cross-Language Knowledge Mapping Database Is All About
description: Cross-language mapping links concepts across tongues: Wikidata's interlanguage links (the multilingual hub), multilingual embeddings (mBERT, XLM-R), and translation bridges. Challenges: untranslatable concepts (the cultural gaps), asymmetric coverage (English-rich, others-poor). The goal: knowledge without language borders — every concept in every tongue.
